entries.text: Do me a favor and go home already, will ya?[VAR 0x0114(002F)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_sitappa_01

entries.text: NO! I wanna see the boss of the Navi Squad!\nTake me to Don Atticus!
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_student_01

entries.text: Like I said, kid, the boss told me not to let any\noutsiders past these gates! That includes you![VAR 0x0114(002F)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_sitappa_02

entries.text: I don’t care! I’m not leaving till you let me talk to\nDon Atticus!
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_student_02

entries.text: Gimme a break, you little doofus...[VAR 0x0114(002F)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_sitappa_03

entries.text: The people over there seem to be arguing about\nsomething... What do you want to do?
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_system_01

entries.text: Go say hello
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_select_01

entries.text: Get a little closer
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_select_02

entries.text: Huh?
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_student_03

entries.text: Oh great. Here comes another rando to ruin\nmy day.[VAR 0x0114(002F)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_sitappa_04

entries.text: I didn’t think grunt work for Team Star newbies\nwould be this much of a chore...[VAR 0x0114(002F)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_sitappa_05

entries.text: Hold on, Mr. Grunt! I think this [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0403)]boygirl might\nbe [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_student_04

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Wait...[VAR 0x0100(0000)]? That kid
who
picked
a
fight
with
Team Star?[VAR 0x0114(002F)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_sitappa_06

entries.text: Yup, that’s me!
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_select_03

entries.text: Prepare to be raided!
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_select_04

entries.text: I knew it!
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_student_05

entries.text: Hoo-boy, this ain’t good![VAR 0x0114(002F)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_sitappa_07

entries.text: Everyone else in the base is still asleep since we\nwere up all last night playing video games...[VAR 0x0114(002F)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_sitappa_08

entries.text: Leave h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer to me, Mr. Grunt! I’ll buy some time\nfor you to go wake up the others!
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_student_06

entries.text: Yeah? And what’s in it for you?[VAR 0x0114(002F)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_sitappa_09

entries.text: Don Atticus will be in danger if no one’s here to\ndefend the base!
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_student_07

entries.text: I owe that man my life. He’s my dear compadre!
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_student_08

entries.text: And when crisis calls, one has no choice but to\nrally to those dear to him—no matter the cost!
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_student_09

entries.text: Yeah, I have no idea what you’re on about, kid.\nBut thanks for the big assist![VAR 0x0114(002F)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_sitappa_10

entries.text: All right, you villain! If you’re after Don Atticus,\nbe prepared to face my wrath!
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_student_10

entries.text: Bring it on
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_select_05

entries.text: Wait a sec!
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_select_06

entries.text: Discretion is the better part of valor, as the\nsaying goes. Wise choice!
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_student_11

entries.text: YAAAAAAH!!!
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_student_12

entries.text: Don Atticus...I’m sorry I failed you...
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_student_13

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! Are you all right?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_nelke_01

entries.text: I was standing watch when I heard a ruckus all of\na sudden.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_nelke_02

entries.text: I got worried that maybe something had\nhappened to you over here...[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_nelke_03

entries.text: Argh... No fair! You had backup this whole time!
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_student_14

entries.text: Is this boy one of the academy’s students?\nHe doesn’t look like he’s from Team Star...[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_nelke_04

entries.text: You’re right—I’m not a member of Team Star...\nbut Don Atticus is my compadre!
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_student_15

entries.text: I have to see him no matter what!
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_student_16

entries.text: Well, clearly you have your reasons for\nbeing here.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_nelke_05

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)]... I’d like to ask this
boy
some
questions.
You
go
ahead
and
get
started
on
the base.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_nelke_06

entries.text: Might I borrow you for a chat, my, ah...my man?\nDon’t worry—I won’t bite.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_010_nelke_07
